title: boardui component node extras
description: Shape of node.extras on component nodes. The components property table is authoritative; these fields duplicate it for generic tools. See spec/README.md §8.4.

instance.description: ID of the component's instance in a panel (spec §6.14).

populate.description: Whether the BOM places the part (spec §8.2); absent without a BOM entry.

attributes.description: The component's BOM attributes by name (spec §8.2); absent when it has none.
